acceptance.native_SOC: A measured production device-owned export passes existing native/branch/identity checks and operator invariants. A failure remains a failure; no fallback is silently substituted.
acceptance.latency: All three fast submissions must produce the requested verified usable result within 300 seconds each, including startup, collection and required review. Record every latency and maximum; no percentile or universal service claim from three samples.
acceptance.response_consistency: Compare fast and fixed-comparator E/F anisotropy responses on both interventions at the unchanged 0.05 meV/cell threshold. Only resolve response sign/ranking above the declared sensitivity. A mismatch fails this local calibration; a pass covers only this three-structure family and comparator.
acceptance.prediction_workflow: Both arms successfully author, preregister, measure, score and revise using independent newly generated outcomes. Report absolute E/F response errors, sign correctness or unresolved status, intervals if supplied, and actual resource usage. No requirement to manufacture a physics-arm win.
acceptance.scientific_advantage: Two heldouts cannot establish general superiority, uncertainty calibration, cross-material transfer or full spec completion; these claims remain unproven even if the tool checks pass.

finite_limits.stop_policy: Build/native/branch/hash/ownership failure stops the remaining sequence. A healthy latency or numerical-consistency failure is recorded; only the already-listed finite cases may continue after review. Never add or replace a case to obtain a pass.
finite_limits.elapsed_planning_allowance: About 1–2 hours including preparation/review; not a provider queue or completion guarantee.
